log.msg:
I'm done and waiting on review. All three changes are committed on `task/honest-completion` (3 commits, not merged):

- **Evidence on `complete`:** `Task.complete` and the item tool now refuse it with
minion-honest-completion its agent is not running: it was stopped on purpose by mastermind-system-architect-2 at 2026-10-22T21:52:50-05:00; not revived.

findings.text: The Task readme's example still calls `step1.complete();` with no evidence (requirement 4). Under the new rule that call is refused, so `step1` stays open and the next line, `build.complete({...evidence})`, is refused too. The example no longer runs as written. diff.patch, `core/Task/readme.md` line 655.

A tab's spawn gets a parent only if the tab passes its own `session_id` to `spawn_agent` (requirement 3). Only the tool's parameter description says to; no tab-side skill or doc does. So a tab that leaves it out still records `parent=null`. The brief asked for the id to come from the MCP request itself, and the diff does not say whether that is possible. diff.patch, `Servex/agents/tools.js` `tab_parent`.

`Task.complete({auto: true})` skips the evidence check for any direct JS caller. The item tool still checks every call (`completion_problem` runs before `auto` is read), so agents can't use it to slip past. Only node code can. diff.patch, `Task.js` complete().

When a subtask nested inside a log completes with caveats, no note is added to the parent log (`!at.target.length`). Its caveats are recorded only on its own line in that same file. That matches the code comment, but it is not what requirement 1 literally asks for. diff.patch, `page_tools.js` line 232.

At 400 the task rows wrap their four buttons onto a second line, and the tab bar is cut off at "FIL". Both were there before this change, since the page diff touches only one call. shots/monorepo-localhost-framework-core-Task-live/400.png, middle band.

answer.reply: fixed: 68e7b3a21, the readme example's step1.complete() passes outcome and evidence.

noted: the MCP request carries no caller session id Servex can read today (tabs reach it as one external client), so the tab passes session_id; the SessionStart hook already gives every tab its id. Loose end: a tab-side line telling tabs to pass it, after the merge.
noted: intended. auto is node's own roll-up when the last child completes; the item tool checks before auto is read, so no agent path skips evidence.
noted: a nested subtask's caveats stay on its own line in the same log the parent reads; a second copy in that file would only repeat it.
noted: pre-existing at 400px, not from this change; left for the Task live page.
